series.name: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)
series.notes: Documented models start at GW250KH-UT (250kW) and GW320K-UT. Utility-scale, so field-replaceable modules are not assumed and the handling text is mostly isolate-and-restart. Bare integers here COLLIDE with the ES-US table and the ESS tables - e.g. UT 1 is SPI Comm Fail while ES-US 1 is Utility Loss, and UT 13 is Vac Failure while ES-US 13 is Abnormal GFCI 60mA. UT is one of the lines GoodWe markets in Pakistan.

meaning.en: The measured grid frequency is outside the allowed range for the configured safety country, so the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency configured safety country ki allowed range se bahar hai, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility grid frequency is outside the allowed range.
causes.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Wrong safety country configured for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye ghalat safety country set hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a clamp meter and log it before touching settings.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se grid frequency measure kar ke settings chhoone se pehle note karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the configured safety country matches the actual grid standard.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke set hua safety country asal grid standard se match karta hai.

solutions.en: If frequency is genuinely out of range, report to the utility; do not widen limits on your own.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency asal mein range se bahar hai to utility ko report karein, limits apni marzi se na barhayein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

title.ur: Insulation fail - string zameen se short (12)

meaning.en: PV string insulation to ground has failed, from a shorted string, a moist site or broken DC cable insulation.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground se insulation fail ho gaya, string short hone, nam site ya DC cable insulation tootne ki wajah se.

causes.ur: PV string ground se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Moist environment with circuit not well insulated to ground.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur circuit ka ground se insulation theek nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the PV input cables are broken.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PV input cables tooti hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Verify module frames and metal brackets are securely grounded.
solutions.ur: Module frames aur metal brackets theek se grounded hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the AC side is properly grounded and measure string-to-earth resistance per string.
solutions.ur: AC side theek se grounded hai ya nahi check karein aur har string ka earth se resistance measure karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: Arc fault protection triggered because a PV string terminal is loose or the DC cable is broken.
meaning.ur: Arc fault protection trigger hua kyunke PV string terminal dhila hai ya DC cable tooti hai.

causes.en: PV string terminal not firmly connected.
causes.ur: PV string terminal dheela band nahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the DC side fully and confirm dead before inspection.
solutions.ur: DC side poori tarah isolate karke inspect karne se pehle dead hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the PV module wiring against the user manual requirements.
solutions.ur: PV module ki wiring ko user manual ki requirements se compare karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate loose connectors with the correct crimp tool; replace heat-damaged parts.
solutions.ur: Dhile connectors sahi crimp tool se dobara lagayein, garmi se kharab hisse replace karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

title.ur: Ground leakage current fail - earth leakage (19)

meaning.en: Input insulation resistance to ground dropped while the inverter was running, so leakage protection tripped.
meaning.ur: Inverter chalne ke daurat input ka ground se insulation resistance gir gaya, is liye leakage protection trigger hua.

causes.en: Input insulation resistance to ground decreases when running.
causes.ur: Chalne par input ka ground se insulation resistance gir jata hai.
Barsaat ke din bohat zyada humidity.

solutions.en: Check the installation working environment meets the manual's requirements.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke installation ka working environment manual ki requirements poora karta hai.

solutions.en: Verify all components and the AC side are properly grounded.
solutions.ur: Sab components aur AC side theek se grounded hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: If it only appears on wet days, log the weather with each event before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf geelay din aaye to kuch bhi replace karne se pehle har event ke saath weather note karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: The inverter was struck by lightning and the surge protective device has failed, so surge protection is no longer available.
meaning.ur: Inverter par lightning gira aur surge protective device kharab ho gaya, is liye surge protection ab nahi hai.

causes.en: SPD device failed after the surge event.
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad SPD device fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Improve the lightning protection facilities around the inverter first.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ke gird lightning protection facilities behtar karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, wait 5 minutes, then re-energise to confirm the trip was surge-related.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karke confirm karein ke trip surge ki wajah se tha.

solutions.en: Visually inspect and continuity-test the SPD, then replace the module.
solutions.ur: SPD visually inspect karein aur continuity test karein, phir module replace karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: The PV string open-circuit voltage is higher than the inverter maximum input voltage because too many modules were connected in series.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum input voltage se zyada hai kyunke series mein zyada modules lage hue hain.

causes.en: Excess PV modules connected in series.
causes.ur: Series mein zyada PV modules lage hue hain.

causes.en: Actual string voltage higher than the value shown on the LCD.
causes.ur: Asal string voltage LCD par dikhne wali value se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Compare the string input voltage with the value displayed on the LCD.
solutions.ur: String ka input voltage LCD par dikhne wali value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the string voltage against the maximum input voltage requirement and reconfigure the string.
solutions.ur: String voltage ko maximum input voltage requirement se check karke string dobara arrange karein.

solutions.en: Never change the string while it is live; open the DC switch and confirm dead first.
solutions.ur: String ko live mein kabhi na badlein, pehle DC switch off karke dead hona confirm karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting
